description: Status and NEW output of a background task: `state` (running | done | failed | killed | timeout), `exit_code`, and the stdout/stderr text produced since the offsets you pass. Start with offsets 0, then pass `stdout_next_offset` / `stderr_next_offset` from the previous response to get only new output. `done: true` means finished. Poll every few seconds; each call is quick. Up to 8 MiB per stream is retained (older output is dropped and reported in `*_dropped`). Requires: token.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

task_id.description: Task id returned by run_code / exec_command with background: true.

name: get_task
title: Poll a background task
